text.autoconfig.chatbabel.title: ChatBabel Settings
text.autoconfig.chatbabel.option.modEnab: Master switch. Turn off to disable every feature of this mod without uninstalling it.
text.autoconfig.chatbabel.option.nativeL: The language everything gets translated INTO.
text.autoconfig.chatbabel.option.display:
Show Translated (hover for original): the chat line shows the translated text, hover it to see what was actually typed.
Show Original (hover for translated): the chat line shows exactly what was typed, hover it to see the translation.
text.autoconfig.chatbabel.option.transla: Which free translation backend to use. Google (unofficial) needs no key/account and works out of the box. LibreTranslate is open-source but the public instance is rate-limited; self-hosting is recommended if you pick it.
text.autoconfig.chatbabel.option.libreTr: Only used when Translation Provider is set to LibreTranslate. Point this at your own self-hosted instance for reliable, unlimited, key-free translation.
text.autoconfig.chatbabel.option.showSou: Adds a second line to the hover tooltip naming the language the message was detected/translated from.
text.autoconfig.chatbabel.option.transla: Automatically detect the language of incoming chat messages and translate them to your native language.
text.autoconfig.chatbabel.option.expandA: Expands common chat slang/acronyms (rn, wdym, smth, idk, brb, ...) into full words before translating, so the translator understands them correctly.
text.autoconfig.chatbabel.option.detectP: Compares words in chat against the current online player list so a username that happens to be a real word in another language (e.g. 'Hola') isn't mistaken for a sentence and mistranslated.
text.autoconfig.chatbabel.option.caesarC: Attempts to detect and decode simple Caesar-shift (ROT-N) ciphered chat messages before translating/displaying them.
text.autoconfig.chatbabel.option.revealO: For same-language messages containing magic/obfuscated (matrix-style scrambling) formatting, hovering over the scrambled text shows what it actually says.
text.autoconfig.chatbabel.option.ignored: Languages that should NEVER be translated (type the exact name shown in the Native Language dropdown, e.g. GERMAN, FRENCH). Leave empty to translate everything.
text.autoconfig.chatbabel.option.transla: Translates the sidebar scoreboard's title. Direct translation only (no hover, matches how the HUD renders).
Translates boss bar names. Direct translation only (no hover).
Translates the big title text shown in the center of the screen. Direct translation only (no hover).
Translates the subtitle text shown below titles. Direct translation only (no hover).
Translates the action bar text shown above the hotbar. Direct translation only (no hover).
